title: Earlier Alcohol-Procedure Violations: Reduction on Dispute (Cartwise Shopper Contractor Accounts)
content:
**Clause.** When an alcohol-procedure dispute is decided on a Cartwise Shopper Contractor Accounts account, the prior-alcohol reduction counts the other alcohol-procedure violations recorded on the account less than twelve whole months before the decision, the disputed one not counted: 2 or more take off 3 points; exactly one takes off 2 points; none takes off nothing.

| Other alcohol-procedure violations in the twelve months before the decision | Prior-alcohol reduction |
|---|---|
| 2 or more | 3 points |
| Exactly 1 | 2 points |
| None | Nothing |

## Counting (hypothetical accounts)

| Alcohol-procedure violations in the twelve months, the disputed one included | Others | Reduction |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | 0 | Nothing |
| 2 | 1 | 2 points |
| 3 | 2 | 3 points |

Only alcohol-procedure violations enter this count; an alcohol-procedure violation recorded more than twelve whole months before the decision does not.
